name: com.clawup/claw-vault
description: Clawup multi-user agent wallet MCP server backed by Privy. Uses JWT context for user/agent ownership and stores provider-neutral wallets in MySQL.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVY_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Privy app ID from the Privy Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: PRIVY_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Privy app secret from the Privy Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: jwt for production, api_key for local/dev

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_JWT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HS256 JWT verification secret for production JWT mode

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for local/dev api_key auth mode

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id used in api_key and stdio modes

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent id used in api_key and stdio modes

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to http for ClawUp deployment

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_ALLOWED_CAIP2
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CAIP-2 chain allowlist for transaction submission
